statement: For 5 oscillators with generic frequencies and generic symmetric complete-graph couplings, the complex count after fixing one phase is 70 = binom(8,4).

source.location: Theorem 3.5, printed pp.7–8; Table 3.1, complete-network row, printed p.10

origin.inheritance_basis: Apply the theorem to the complete graph on 5 vertices, with one vertex fixed as the reference phase.

notes:
Direct evaluation of the complete-graph adjacency-polytope volume formula.

The complete-network binomial count is credited to Baillieul–Byrnes in Chen–Korchevskaia–Lindberg. The latter remains cited for its explicit genericity theorem with symmetric couplings; the general graph theorem is a separate result.

John Baillieul; Christopher I. Byrnes, Geometric critical point analysis of lossless power system models (1982, article ID baillieul_byrnes_1982_power_flow). Historical attribution recorded by the cited supporting article. No separately inspected result locator in this earlier article was recorded for this result.
